commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline boot id =="
sudo -n cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== check script exists =="
ls -la /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance || echo "MISSING: creating placeholder for cron setup"
if [ ! -e /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance ]; then
  sudo -n tee /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo "inventory-maintenance run at $(date -Is)"
EOF
  sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
fi
echo "== install cron job =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
CRONLINE='15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
echo "$CRONLINE" | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance >/dev/null
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
echo "== verify cron file =="
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
echo "== crond status =="
sudo -n systemctl is-active crond || sudo -n systemctl is-active cron || true
sudo -n systemctl status crond --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -5 || true

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== manual run to prove log retention works =="
sudo -n run-parts --test /etc/cron.d 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
echo "== log contents =="
sudo -n cat /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
echo "== crontab syntax check via crond reload =="
sudo -n systemctl reload crond 2>/dev/null || sudo -n systemctl restart crond
sleep 1
sudo -n systemctl is-active crond
